payload.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T08:23:04Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T08:53:04Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| EVAL event_type = CASE(
    message LIKE "*Failed password*", "failed_password",
    message LIKE "*Invalid user*", "invalid_user",
    message LIKE "*Accepted*", "accepted",
    message LIKE "*pam_unix*", "pam_unix",
    "other"
  )
| STATS failed_password_count = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "failed_password",
        invalid_user_count = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "invalid_user",
        pam_unix_success_count = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "pam_unix" AND event.outcome == "success",
        pam_unix_failure_count = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "pam_unix" AND event.outcome == "failure",
        accepted_count = COUNT(*) WHERE event_type == "accepted",
        first_event = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_event = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip

questions.q: In the row where pam_unix_success_count is 0, what is the value of pam_unix_failure_count?
How many rows does this payload contain?
Which last_event has the largest failed_password_count?
